intro: Hi! I'm the Blitz Wallet bot. I connect to the Wallet Connect account in your Blitz app. It's separate from your main wallet, so I can only use the money you keep there. With me you can check your balance, ask for money and pay people right here in Telegram. Stay safe: never share your PIN or secret backup words with anyone.
help: What can I do? Money /balance – See your balance /receive – Ask for money /send – Pay a payment request /transactions – See your recent payments /status – See what you paid and asked for here Your connection /connect – Connect your Wallet Connect account /reconnect – Connect again to change permissions or your PIN /disconnect – Disconnect your Wallet Connect account /language – Change language Good to know • I use the Wallet Connect account in your Blitz app, not your main wallet. • Money is counted in sats. A sat is a tiny piece of bitcoin. • To ask for money in any chat, type @{{bot}} 5000 pizza and tap the box that pops up. • In groups, this only works if members may Send Stickers & GIFs (group settings → Permissions).
